input_normalization: raw counts scattered onto the fixed 19,264-gene order (unmeasured genes = 0), then read-depth-aware scFoundation transform: rd = max(log10(total), 5); x = log1p(x / total * 1e4); x = concat([x, rd, rd]); clamp(x, max=20). Sequence length 19,266.
output_semantics: one scalar per gene position (the model's masked-language-model regression target, i.e. predicted high-read-depth expression on the log1p CP10K scale); the last two positions are read-depth tokens and are dropped
information_flow: bidirectional encoder (18 layers) over the full fixed gene order
symmetry_evidence: bidirectional attention plus absolute position embeddings over a fixed gene order; every gene sees every other gene, but pairwise symmetry was not measured here Cross-entry measurement inconclusive: the Jacobian estimate itself is step-dependent here (primary vs cross-check Pearson 0.9991, relative L2 difference 1.3788), so the asymmetry cannot be separated from estimation error

jacobian_check.cross_check_method: second central finite difference at step=1

substitutions: replaced BertSelfFlashAttention.forward with a shape-correct SDPA implementation: the shipped non-flash fallback softmaxes across heads instead of across the sequence, and the flash-attention path is fp16/bf16 only with no forward-mode derivative. Weights and attention mathematics are unchanged; the kernel and dtype are not.
